name: Mocha Latte
caffeineNote: Brand states 200 mg on its listing; not yet checked against a label
summary: Zero-sugar mocha cold brew latte on oat milk, the sibling of Loco's vanilla can and listed at the same 200 mg of caffeine per 11 oz. As with that one, we have not read its panel: the brand's zero-sugar claim would put it at the top of our least-sugar list, so the sugar column stays blank until a label confirms it.
